summary.value: The Empire Hotel New York, steps from Lincoln Center & Central Park, is a well-placed hotel where guests praise nice staff, quick check-in and clean rooms, ideal for performance nights. The building is old, and some rooms are tiny with noisy older air conditioning.

description.value: The Empire Hotel New York sits steps from Lincoln Center & Central Park and offers Stylish Art Deco rooms and a vibrant rooftop bar that is a draw on its own. Trip.com guests rate it 7.8 / 10 Good 112 reviews and say Staff was generally quite nice, with fast, friendly check-in. Honest watch-outs: the hotel is quite old, and some rooms are tiny with old fashioned floor air conditioner which was very loud.

itineraryNote: The Empire Hotel New York: steps from Lincoln Center & Central Park with friendly staff; try the vibrant rooftop bar before the opera.
review1: Staff at The Empire Hotel are generally described as pleasant and helpful, setting a friendly tone for the stay near Lincoln Center.
review2: Rooms are reported as clean, and check-in is described as fast and friendly, which guests appreciate after a long journey into the city.
review3: The location opposite Lincoln Center and close to Central Park is the hotel's standout feature for theater, concert and park visits.
review4: The building is older and it shows in places, so guests suggest treating it as a well-placed classic hotel rather than a modern one.
